videos.title: Nanami: Storm | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Liv: Eclipse". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Nanami: Storm is the starter Tank character of the Gray Raven squad, debuted in December 5, 2019. As a B-Rank Physical Tank, she excels at breaking enemy defenses (Yellow Bars) and providing protection for the team.

🔴 Utility: Her kit focuses on defense reduction and crowd control. She is vital for shredding enemy armor, allowing your DPS characters to deal significantly more damage.
🔴 Core Passive (Ex-Axe Storm): By triggering any 3-Ping followed immediately by at least 1-Yellow Ping orb, Nanami performs a powerful spinning attack. This maneuver deals massive Physical damage and greatly increases her damage reduction, allowing her to stay in the fray while disrupting enemy formations.

Official Links -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PGR Official Site: pgr.kurogame.net
Kuro Games: kurogames.com
Official Twitter (X): @PGR_GLOBAL
Follow Me[ ][ ][ ]

#punishinggrayraven #pgrglobal #kurogames #gacha #games

Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Liv: Lux". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Liv: Lux is an A-Rank frame for Liv that debuted on December 5, 2019. As an A-Rank Lightning Support, she is a staple for Lightning-focused squads, offering both utility and elemental buffs.

🔴 Utility: Lux specializes in area-of-effect healing and crowd control. Her Yellow Orb (Sanctum) creates a zone that pulls enemies in and reduces their Lightning Resistance, making them vulnerable to your team's burst damage.
🔴 Core Passive (Lightning Lure): By attacking a marked enemy (from Basic Attacks or Red Orbs), Liv has a chance to trigger a Lightning Lure. After triggering this 4 times, the next Lure summons Ex - Lightning Lure, which deals massive Lightning damage and heals all allies within the area based on a percentage of her Attack.

Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Sophia: Silverfang". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sophia: Silverfang is an A-Rank frame for Sophia that debuted on March 19, 2020. As an A-Rank Fire Support, she provides essential utility for Fire squads, specializing in Fire damage buffs and a unique "energy orb" healing mechanic.

🔴 Utility: Sophia is a highly mobile support who uses her robotic arms and pistols to attack from mid-range. Her Blue Orb is her primary tool for gathering enemies, creating a small gravity field that pulls them together for your main DPS to finish off.
🔴 Core Passive (Thermal Energy): By triggering any 3-Ping, Sophia generates Energy Orbs on the battlefield. When any teammate picks up these orbs, they receive a heal and a Fire Damage bonus. This requires the player to be more active in their positioning to collect heals, rewarding those who master her high-speed movement.

videos.title: Ayla: Kaleido | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Ayla: Kaleido". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Ayla: Kaleido is an S-Rank frame for Ayla that debuted on November 17, 2022. As the cornerstone S-Rank Ice Amplifier, she provides crucial team-wide element boosts and continuous healing while dishing out top-tier, field-clearing burst damage.

🔴 Utility: Ayla completely solidifies Ice team compositions by acting as a highly efficient sub-DPS and support. Her unique Amplifier class trait increases the overall elemental damage of her allies, allowing her to smoothly swap into combat, deploy massive active buffs, and unleash heavy burst damage before passing the field back to your main attacker.

🔴 Core Passive (Color Symphony): By triggering 3-Pings, Ayla mixes different colored pigments on her artistic palette. Matching specific color combinations unlocks unique Canvas Skills, allowing her to paint massive, explosive graffiti waves across the battlefield that group enemies together and heavily reduce their Ice Resistance. Her Signature Move splashes a tidal wave of icy paint across the arena, dealing immense AoE Ice damage to all captured targets.

Official Links -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
PGR Official Site: pgr.kurogame.net
Kuro Games: kurogames.com
Official Twitter (X): @PGR_GLOBAL
Follow Me[ ][ ][ ]

Copyright Disclaimer ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
All gameplay footage, characters, music, and art assets featured in this video are the property of Kuro Games. This video is created for entertainment and educational purposes under Fair Use. I do not own the rights to the game Punishing: Gray Raven.

videos.title: Lucia: Crimson Weave | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Lucia: Crimson Weave". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Lucia: Crimson Weave is an S-Rank frame for Lucia that debuted on December 24, 2022. As the absolute apex Lightning Attacker, she completely redefined high-speed combat in the game, utilizing a hyper-aggressive, dual-blade stance loop to tear through enemy defenses at lightning speed.

🔴 Utility: Lucia dominates the field with unrivaled mobility, screen-wide tracking, and continuous invincibility frames. Her kit is designed for relentless offense, allowing her to instantly gap-close across the arena, group scattered enemies together, and unleash nonstop Lightning burst damage without ever dropping her combo momentum.

🔴 Core Passive (Unwavering Stance): Holding down the basic attack button allows Lucia to enter a high-speed バイク (Motorcycle) / Charging State, rapidly building up her combat gauge. Once full, she enters her enhanced stance where her skill orbs transform into lethal, light-speed slashes that completely bypass enemy super armor. Her Signature Move unleashes a devastating, screen-clearing storm of slash waves that shatters all defensive parameters and deals catastrophic Lightning elemental damage.

Kuro Games: kurogames.com

videos.title: No.21: Feral | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "No.21: Feral". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Ayla: Kaleido is an S-Rank frame for Ayla that debuted on November 17, 2022. As the cornerstone S-Rank Ice Amplifier, she provides crucial team-wide element boosts and continuous healing while dishing out top-tier, field-clearing burst damage.

No.21: Feral (often referred to as No.21: Feral Scent) is an S-Rank frame for No.21 that debuted on March 23, 2023. As a premier S-Rank Lightning Attacker, she brings a wild, beast-like, hyper-mobile playstyle to the Lightning team, tearing through enemy lines with ferocious claw strikes and overwhelming speed.

🔴 Utility: No.21 specializes in continuous, high-frequency melee pressure. She excels at staying glued to targets, bypassing enemy evasion mechanics with her feral dashes, and aggressively locking down mobile bosses while automatically generating massive shields to keep herself safe in the heat of battle.

🔴 Core Passive (Hunting Instinct): Triggering 3-Pings or successfully dodging enemy attacks builds up her Feral Gauge. When the gauge peaks, No.21 enters a wild hunting state where she leaps onto enemies to deliver rapid-fire claw slashes that deal dense AoE Lightning damage. Her Signature Move lets her unleash her companion, Co-Bot, to trap all surrounding targets in a massive electrical prison before she executes a final, catastrophic diving bite that tears apart enemy super armor.

videos.title: Alisa: Echo | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Alisa: Echo". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Alisa: Echo is an S-Rank frame for Alisa that debuted on June 8, 2023. As a premier S-Rank Physical Amplifier, she acts as the ultimate cornerstone for physical teams, flawlessly blending team-wide offensive buffs and consistent healing with devastating bow attacks.

🔴 Utility: Alisa provides critical, high-value attribute boosts to physical squads, significantly multiplying the critical hit rates and raw damage of her allies. Her long-range archery allows her to safely apply defense-shredding debuffs via her QTE, making her an indispensable asset for maximizing the team's burst windows.

🔴 Core Passive (Duet Harmony): Triggering 3-Pings allows Alisa to summon her giant mechanical puppet, Seraph, to the battlefield to fight alongside her. Together, they execute synchronized dual attacks that pull enemies into a centralized point while dropping their Physical Resistance. Her Signature Move stops the stage timer completely, letting her fire a cataclysmic barrage of light arrows that rain down for massive, screen-clearing AoE Physical damage.

videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Lamia: Lost Lullaby". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Lamia: Lost Lullaby is an S-Rank frame for Lamia that debuted on July 20, 2023. As a premier S-Rank Dark Attacker, she dominates Dark elemental teams with a fluid, tide-warping combat loop that allows her to manipulate sea currents and transform her physical state mid-battle.

🔴 Utility: Lamia specializes in wide-area crowd control, continuous vacuum pulls, and massive field-clearing burst. Her highly elusive movements allow her to slip past enemy lines effortlessly, gathering scattered targets into tight waves while consistently stacking up heavy Dark damage multipliers.

🔴 Core Passive (Abyssal Metamorphosis): Triggering 3-Pings fills her tidal gauge and allows her to summon explosive water pillars. When her energy peaks, she enters a specialized stance that transforms her lower body into a mermaid form. In this state, she glides across the battlefield with hyper-mobility, transforming her skill orbs into high-frequency, reality-splitting sea-storms that drag enemies down and completely shred their elemental resistance.

◯攻撃の射程が長く複数を巻き込んで攻撃可能。強化特殊スキル、終結スキルも遠距離攻撃なので外す心配がない。
◯強化特殊スキルが敵を貫通してヒットするため複数相手の際非常に便利。慣れると他の撃破のエージェントの範囲の狭さにがっかりするレベル。
◯ある程度表で使う必要のあった撃破キャラと比べ出場時間が短くて済む。基本的に強攻を出しっぱなしで使うだけで良いためアクションゲームとしてはかなり楽になる。
◯一撃の倍率は低いが使い方次第で常時追加攻撃をし続けられるためずっと裏で殴り続けてくれる状態にできる。
◯追加攻撃は長射程でプレイスキルに依存せず確実に攻撃が当たるため、人によってはS撃破のエージェントよりも早くブレイクできる。
◯撃破と組み合わせれば一瞬でブレイクできるので敵に攻撃させず一方的にボコボコに殴れて楽しい。
◯トリガーと違い追加攻撃にクールタイムがない。複数雑魚処理のブレイクであればプルクラの方が早い場合も。
◯「追加攻撃バフ30％」という持ち味はあるので今後実装されるキャラ次第では強い部類に入る（かもしれない）。完凸なら現状でもかなり有用。

【悪いところ８つ】
✕キャラ入れ替えの操作をミスすると猟歩状態が切れてしまう。基本使い勝手が良いだけに非常にもったいない仕様だなと感じる。
✕猟歩状態に入る度特殊スキルか強化特殊スキルで発動してあげる必要があり慣れるまで若干手間。かつ重撃という条件がありパイパーやカリンなどモーション長いエージェントと噛み合いが悪い。（シーザーアストラどちらか入れてると楽になる）
✕コアパッシブの継続時間6秒の仕様がマジでクソ。なんでこんな縛り付けた?　切替時に猟歩状態が切れる使用も相まって使いづらい仕様になってる。
✕追加能力条件が強攻or自陣営タイプなので若干だが編成に偏りが出てしまう。初期キャラもこの仕様撤廃してくれたら使いやすくなるしもうやめたらいいのに。
✕撃破キャラだがパリィ支援できないので危局強襲戦のテューボーンなどパリィ→部位破壊が必要なボスには使いづらい。
✕単体特化の撃破キャラではないのでボス相手のブレイク稼ぎはS撃破運用の方が早い。
✕攻撃の誘導距離が長すぎるので突然関係ない敵にロックオンが吸われることがある。終結も同様。（そもそものロックオンの仕様がクソ）
✕せっかくモーションがかっこいいのに表でのアタッカー運用は無理過ぎる倍率。どう見てもジェーンのように表で使う想定で作られていたボスモーションのはずなのに「追加攻撃撃破」の被検体にされた感がひどい。

あと終結スキルがダサい（個人的な意見）

・激変での使用感ではシャドウ４、ペッカー２で十分な感じでした。
・プロトパンク４をもたせるバッファー運用も試しましたがそこまでメインアタッカーのDPSに影響はなかったです。（プルクラ自体が出すダメージも含めるとシャドウ4とそこまで差がない印象）
・追加攻撃の異常蓄積は低いので異常運用は向いていませんでした。
・ジェーン+シーザー、ジェーン+バーニスの異常チームに組み込む分には使い勝手も良かったのでプルクラ完凸or該当エージェントのモチーフ音動機を持ってるなら選択肢に入るかもしれません。

videos.title: Lucia: Pyroath | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.
🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Lucia: Pyroath". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Lucia: Pyroath is an S-Rank frame for Lucia that debuted on July 11, 2024. As a premier S-Rank Fire Attacker, she infuses the Fire team with raw, unstoppable destructive force, wielding a massive, blazing greatsword to cleave through enemy formations.

🔴 Utility: Lucia: Pyroath dominates the field with wide, sweeping AoE strikes and relentless close-range pressure. Her attack animations provide immense stagger resist and crowd-control properties, allowing her to continuously gather enemies while heating them up for massive multipliers.

🔴 Core Passive (Blazing Forge): Consuming 3-Pings charges her weapon's thermal core. Once her gauge fills completely, holding down the basic attack button prompts her to slam her greatsword down, entering an enhanced Overheat State. In this stance, her blade extends with raw plasma fire, transforming all standard basic attacks into heavy kinetic shockwaves that completely ignore enemy defensive parameters and shred Fire Resistance.

Kuro Games: kurogames.com
Official Twitter (X): @PGR_GLOBAL

videos.title: Ishmael: Parhelion | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finisher | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Ishmael: Parhelion". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Ishmael: Parhelion is an S-Rank frame for Ishmael that debuted on November 7, 2024. She introduced a completely revolutionary and unique class type to the game: the Universal Omniframing class, acting as a flexible cornerstone who can adapt to any team composition on the fly.

🔴 Utility: Ishmael functions as an omni-elemental catalyst, shifting her damage profile to match the exact elemental typing of your current team (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Dark, Physical, or Annihilation). Her active presence or QTE automatically applies a massive 30% resistance reduction matching that team's dominant element, completely streamlining high-tier team rotations.

🔴 Core Passive (Parhelion Refraction): Triggering 3-Pings accumulates Prismatic Energy in her core. When her energy is maxed out, holding down the basic attack button allows Ishmael to open a reality rift that clusters every enemy on the field together while granting her squad temporary stagger immunity. Her Signature Move stops the stage timer entirely, refracting light into a massive planetary beam that shatters enemy defenses and deals devastating, multi-hit elemental burst damage.

Activating these Red Orbs triggers instant Matrix shifts, groups up surrounding targets, and rapidly builds up to five unique Card Stacks on her gauge. videos.title: Jetavie: Daybreak | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Jetavie: Daybreak". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Jetavie: Daybreak is an A-Rank frame for Jetavie that debuted on March 6, 2025. Breaking the mold as a highly anticipated and unique A-Rank Dark Attacker, she functions as a brilliant budget partner to pair alongside S-Rank frames like Lilith: Daemonissa.

🔴 Utility: Jetavie specializes in high-frequency, rapid-fire ranged kiting using her custom Fusion Gunsword. She features incredible beginner-friendly utility, including unique auto-dodge and auto-block mechanics built directly into her charging animations to protect players during combat setups.

🔴 Core Passive (Absurdum Calibration): All of Jetavie's standard signal orbs translate into specialized Cluster Orbs used to fuel her technical state loops. By holding her Yellow or Blue Orbs, she consumes these clusters to deploy an automated aim-bot tracking barrage. Tapping her initial Signature Move activates her "old state" and unlocks her Red Orbs, enabling a complex duality flow where she can seamlessly alternate between pure Dark damage strings or heavy, damage-over-time Ignition / Combustible elemental impacts.

Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Bianca: Crepuscule". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Bianca: Crepuscule is an S-Rank frame for Bianca that debuted on July 3, 2025. Arriving as the definitive, meta-defining S-Rank Dark Attacker, she completely took over the Dark element meta by offering unmatched damage parameters and a highly adaptive dual-form combat engine.

🔴 Utility: Bianca is designed for hyper-optimal field control and rapid wave clearing as your primary Dark damage dealer, effectively succeeding older frames like Lamia. Her playstyle is extremely fluid, allowing players to swap her combat states on the fly to tailor her elemental attacks and off-field properties directly to the combat environment.

🔴 Core Passive (Eventide & Dawnlight Forms): Bianca shifts seamlessly between two distinct battle stances:Twilight / Eventide Form: In this form, she deals raw 100% Dark elemental damage and commands only Red and Blue Orbs. Holding down her dodge button activates her localized Abyssal Domain, pulling in enemies and filling her central gauge while generating Red Orbs to unleash high-impact continuous slash combinations.Radiance / Dawnlight Form: Swapping states transitions her to command Yellow and Blue Orbs, transforming her damage profile to deal specialized Glow / Radiance damage. Here, spamming triple Yellow pings rapidly builds up her weapon gauge to trigger devastating swordstaff strikes that shatter armor mechanics.

videos.title: Teddy: Spectre | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Teddy: Spectre". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Teddy: Spectre is an S-Rank frame for Teddy that debuted on December 23, 2025. Stepping out of her standard utility style, she is the premier, generation-defining S-Rank Ice Amplifier designed to pack incredible healing and squad-wide offensive multipliers.

🔴 Utility: Teddy acts as the absolute cornerstone buffer and sub-DPS for high-tier Ice squads. In addition to her essential healing, her class trait heavily elevates elemental damage output, seamlessly slotting into optimal rotations with characters like Wanshi: Lucid Dreamer. She can also trigger the specialized Raydiance / Radiant effect to drop concentrated plasma bursts on targets for supplementary damage bursts.

🔴 Core Passive (Data Domain): Base combat loops restrict her action parameters exclusively to unique White Orbs. Pinging these coordinates records colored values that charge up her signature parameters. Activating her Signature Move expands the battlefield into her digital Data Domain, forcing a massive spatial shift that automatically clusters targets together while dropping their Ice Resistance. While in this domain, her movement shifts to a hyper-fluid, action-game rhythm using her Digital Warboots to string high-multiplier strikes.

videos.title: Rosetta: Arete | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Rosetta: Arete". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Rosetta: Arete is an S-Rank frame for Rosetta that debuted on February 3, 2026 in the Withering Crown patch. Breaking her traditional tank archetype, she introduces the brand-new Breaker class and acts as a specialized 100% Dark elemental damage dealer.

🔴 Utility: Codenamed "Malkuth," Arete can freely switch between her human and robotic centaur forms to launch attacks that break normal power limits. Her primary role is a dedicated shield-breaker and defense shredder, rapidly lowering enemy Dark Resistance to set up aggressive, tempo-driven combat loops for your main Dark damage dealers.

🔴 Core Passive & Rotation: Activating her mechanics requires a color-stacking gray-scale loop. Pinging two Red Orbs followed by a held basic attack charges her core gauge to build a stack. Swapping over to tap Blue Orbs and holding basic attack adds her second stack, fully enabling her to tap her signature shift into Centaur Form. While in Centaur Form, she triggers the specialized Ultima Slash effect—modifying her computational output to drop a cataclysmic, armor-shattering dark cavalry charge across the field.

videos.title: Nirvatia: Dirge | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Nirvatia: Dirge". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Nirvatia: Dirge is an S-Rank frame for Nirvatia that debuted on March 17, 2026 in the Chinese server release. She enters the roster as a specialized Physical Support / Amplifier character designed to anchor high-tier physical team compositions.

🔴 Utility: Nirvatia: Dirge excels at continuous field control and burst-window amplification. Her primary utility centers on her ability to generate a localized gravity well upon entering the field, pulling in smaller mobs and keeping them grouped. Simultaneously, her passive aura applies a persistent physical defense reduction to all affected targets, significantly lowering the barrier for your primary physical damage dealers to burst through tough armor pools.

🔴 Core Passive & Rotation: Activating her rotation requires executing a strict rhythmic orb-ping sequence. Pinging any 3-Orb combination triggers her "Grave Melody" stance, causing her next basic attack to transform into a sweeping scythe strike that builds her internal Requiem Gauge. Once the gauge is filled to maximum, a held basic attack consumes all energy to execute her Dirge Finale. This high-impact finisher bursts the gravity well, deals massive physical damage, and instantly triggers the QTE of your off-field team members to maximize rotation speed.If

videos.title: Kamui: Aeternio | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as Kamui: Aeternio". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Kamui: Aeternion is an S-Rank frame for Kamui that debuted on March 17, 2026. He enters the roster as a specialized Fire / Plasma Beam Breaker character designed to anchor high-tier damage compositions.

🔴 Utility: Kamui: Aeternion excels at field management and elemental vulnerability application. His primary utility centers on his dual weapon forms, allowing him to seamlessly pivot between high-impact area-of-effect suppression and focused shield breaking. Simultaneously, his presence provides dynamic resistance shredding, significantly lowering defense thresholds for secondary off-field damage dealers to exploit during tight rotation windows.

🔴 Core Passive & Rotation: Activating his rotation requires managing his weapon state transitions. Pinging his Yellow Orb triggers his "Discharge Form," automatically converting Blue Orbs to Red Orbs to rapidly build his internal gauge. Once maximum charge is achieved, a held basic attack consumes his accumulated energy to execute his high-impact elemental burst, which pauses time, deals massive localized damage, and instantly triggers team QTEs to maximize rotation speed.

Official Links -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Kuro Games: kurogames.com
Official Twitter (X): @PGR_GLOBAL

videos.title: Jiuyuan Animations Showcase (Combat, Exploration, Menu, Unique Skills)
videos.description:
A showcase of Jiuyuan's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

Jiuyuan's animations feel really floaty and flashy (in a show-offy kind of way, not bright), which took a while for me to get a proper feel for, but now I think I like them a lot more than I did initially.
Her personality, I feel, is VERY much showcased in her attack animations. Her calm and collectedness is very present in each attack, and in some, it even feels like she's more so just having fun, almost like she's dancing with her enemies (her burst shows that off REALLY well, and is THE best part of her animations).
As someone who's a sucker for the subtle parts of animations, I REALLY like how much she twirls her gun after most of her attacks. It just looks so satisfying each time. 9/10 for me

videos.description:
A showcase of Nanally's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

I think overall, all of Nanally's animations are quite even in quality, with the best being her basic and charged attacks, of course. I like how she uses a mix of kicks and punches, both feeling just as strong as the other. I also really like how you can really feel the oomph coming out of Nanally's basic attacks (the amazing sound design is also a big factor of it), her charged attacks amplifying that oomph times TEN, with each hit feeling like you're hitting the enemies with trucks. Her weakest link only being her Redirect Skill, which still feels really impactful cuz the effects make up for the weird animation. The little animations she does after each attack are also really cute and add to her personality. 10/10 for me.

videos.title: Daffodil Animations Showcase (Combat, Exploration, Menu, Unique Skills) | Neverness to Everness
videos.description:
A showcase of Daffodil's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

HUGE bias here (as a Daffodil main), but I think Daffodil has THE best animations in the game as of now.
Her basic attacks feel precise, strong, and very heavy. Yet, the way she moves her blades around shows how light they are in comparison.
I know not many people pay attention to all the animations after each attack (I personally LOVE seeing how each animation transitions to the idle), but I especially love how she readjusts her blades by either spinning them around, or lightly tossing them in the air, then catching them (which, again, shows how little they really weigh).
My favorite attack of hers (besides her attack dash, since it isn't really an "attack") would definitely be her enhanced Redirect Skill. It just feels REALLY strong, and the blade waves look very visually pleasing. And the animation for it is top-notch, with her using her chains to attach her blades to her heel, then her getting the blades back into her hands with said chains is just perfection.
Her burst has got to be the best one by far. The opening animation with her getting a burning eye, then hitting a killer pose while a BIGGER eye opens up behind her is just so cool. And even after that opening animation, the attack afterwards, with the rain of chains, and her just standing in the midst of it, pure AURA.
So... yeah. Pretty sure you get the idea on how much I love Daffodil. 11/10 for me.

videos.title: Aurelia Animations Showcase (Combat, Exploration, Menu, Unique Skills) | Neverness to Everness
videos.description:
A showcase of Aurelia's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

Gonna be honest with you, I completely forgot she existed, which is why I fogor to record hers before doing the male characters (besides Jiuyuan & Fadia, cuz I don't have 'em). And being even MORE honest, I think she's got the worst animations in the game, and it's not even CLOSE.
As I started recording, it became really clear what their intentions were when animating her (which you could probably tell from the higher angles I recorded in), which kinda really extremely sucks, cuz I actually like the fact that we have an actual disabled character that makes sense for them to still be playable, but they HAD to make her flash the camera the most out of ALL the other characters.
For her animations, I like how she acts like a conductor for her attacks, but that's pretty much it. Most of her animations are just her waving her stick around (while flashing everyone around her), with a bit of bubbles and water splashing in an area. One attack in particular that pisses me off is her fourth (and final, for some reason) basic attack, where she summons a floaty tube and rubber duckies for some reason??? COMPLETELY unrelated to her design and character, besides the fact that she attacks with water.
If you're gonna release another disabled character in the future, please don't flash her underwear a million in her animations again. 0/10 for me.

One thing I didn't know was that she could ride motorcycles herself, until I someone else do it, which I think is a really cool unique feature of hers (and I hope that gets extended to more characters in the future). 7/10 for me.

videos.title: Hotori Animations Showcase (Combat, Exploration, Menu, Unique Skills)
videos.description:
A showcase of Hotori's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

Since Hotori is an ultimate-focused character, it's only natural for her to have the best ultimate animations (including the ultimate attacks) in the game. One thing I really appreciate is how even her ultimate attacks each have their own sheathing animation (and BOY am I glad her ultimate recharges over time so I didn't have to farm energy over and over again to showcase each one). It's something they didn't HAVE to do, but it really shows how much effort they put into each character's animations. They even added a PLUNGE attack for her ultimate, even though no one would even THINK of plunging during it (I fogor to showcase it cuz of that mb). The rest of her animations are just fine for me, but I also do like the way she floats with her umbrella after her basic attacks, which are just nice to look at. 7/10 for me.

Guess I'm a showcase channel now.

videos.title: Lucia: Inverse Crown | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Lucia: Inverse Crown". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Lucia: Inverse Crown is an S-Rank frame for Lucia that debuted on June 2, 2026. She enters the roster as a specialized Ice / Ignition Attacker character designed to unleash rapid sword combos and massive burst damage.

🔴 Utility: Lucia: Inverse Crown excels at seamless form-switching and high-frequency parrying. Her primary utility centers on her dual stance mechanic, shifting between an Odachi (long sword) form for mid-to-long-range suppression and a Kodachi (short sword) form for rapid close-quarters slashes. Both forms allow her to actively block and parry enemy attacks, triggering safe offensive counter-windows while simultaneously applying an Ice-based "Ignition" effect to shred targets over time.

🔴 Core Passive & Rotation: Activating her rotation requires cycling her stance states by holding down her designated Red or Blue Orb inputs. This automates a high-velocity sequence that naturally threads Yellow Orbs into her attack string, automatically generating specialized command combos. Once her core loops fully charge her resource bars, she can cast up to three devastating Signature Move variants—culminating in Silenced Abysslight—to freeze the battlefield and deal extreme burst damage.

videos.title: Lacrimosa Animations Showcase (Combat, Exploration, Menu, Unique Skills) | Neverness to Everness
videos.description:
A showcase of Lacrimosa's gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of her animations.

If I ranked characters by the amount of animations they have, then Lacrimosa would be 1st PLACE with how many animations they stuffed into her kit. But unfortunately, this feels a bit like a "quantity over quality" scenario.
Lacrimosa's animations feel very 'basic', in a way that's comparable to most of the standard characters we have now. Not necessarily bad, but nothing that special either. I guess you could argue that it fits into her character and personality, which I would actually agree with! Her little bits of animation after each attack, with her nodding off a bit I find really cute.
One itty bitty problem I have with her animations tho, are the fact that she barely has any facial expression, or any facial movement at all during her MELEE basic attacks. And though you could argue her full body animations are lackluster because of her character & personality, you can't say the same for her facial expression, SPECIFICALLY in this case, because she doesn't even look at where she's hitting. It's not really that big of an issue, but I really like observing all the details and animations of each character, and was disappointed that she barely has any facial expressions during most of her attacks. 6/10 for me.

videos.title: Chaos Animations Showcase (Combat, Exploration, Menu, Unique Skills)
videos.description:
A showcase of Chaos' gameplay to fully appreciate every detail in each of his animations.

For a male character, I think Chaos has some really good looking animations, and could probably be on the top of my list. I say "probably" with a lot of weight on it, because, funnily enough, the problem IS the lack of weight behind any of his animations, which is a glaring problem that I feel holds back most of Chaos' animations.
The way he hits with his scythe-blade around FEELS like it should weigh a lot, ESPECIALLY since it looks like it's made fully of metal (or a metal-like material), but the way he moves it around, especially during the transitions back to his idle, make it look like it weighs NOTHING. That would be a good thing, if we were talking from a gameplay perspective, but from an animation POV, it kinda takes away from any of the impact any of the attacks would've had otherwise if they had any weight put into them.
Seeing the animations in actual gameplay is still really smooth, and the SFX do help a lot as well, so I think they were more focused on making his animations quicker (although weightless), just so they don't feel slow or laggy, which is fine with me. 7/10 for me.

videos.title: Helentine: Lacrimosa | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Helentine: Lacrimosa". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Helentine: Lacrimosa is an S-Rank frame for Helentine that debuted on July 16, 2026. She joins the roster as a specialized 100% Lightning / Glaciation Amplifier character designed to dominate dual-affix rotations while offering top-tier team healing and utility.

🔴 Utility: Helentine: Lacrimosa excels at sub-DPS elemental support and structural field setup. Her primary utility centers on her signature Folding Buzzsaw (Hear the Bell) and the application of the unique Glaciation Effect, which generates a low-temperature parameter zone on the field. Within this zone, her continuous attacks build up specialized parameters over time, steadily stripping enemy defense thresholds while granting her massive personal damage reduction and off-field damage amplification for her squad.

🔴 Core Passive & Rotation: Activating her rotation focuses on a multi-stance combat loop and heavy Damage-over-Time (DoT) setup. Pinging 3-Orb combinations switches her between tactical stances to trigger her Scrutiny, Cathexis, and Regression skills, which rapidly generate Signal Orbs and fill her core meter. Once her bars cross their active threshold, casting her Ultimate dumps her accumulated energy into a devastating Metaphor Surge burst, refreshing her active debuffs and triggering the off-field team QTEs necessary to maximize the party's rotation windows.

videos.title: Karenina: Effulgence | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

About "Frames" ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In PGR, character names follow a specific format, such as "Karenina: Effulgence". The first part is the character’s name, and the part after the colon is their Frame name. 

A Frame is a specialized mechanical body. It is important to know that Constructs were originally Humans who chose to undergo a surgical transformation, uploading their consciousness (MIND) into these artificial bodies to fight the Punishing Virus. Because they are now biomechanical, they can switch between different Frames designed for different combat roles or elements. While the person remains the same, a new Frame gives them entirely different abilities and playstyles.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Karenina: Effulgence is an S-Rank Omniframe for Karenina that debuted on August 19, 2026. She enters the roster as a highly mobile Physical / Darkflow Breaker character designed with naval-combat mechanics to aggressively shred enemy defenses.

🔴 Utility: Karenina: Effulgence excels at high-mobility field control and dynamic resistance reduction. Her primary utility is anchored by her specialized class properties, allowing her to continuously strip targets of both Physical and Darkflow resistances. Additionally, her defensive mechanics grant her super armor and structural block frames, converting raw incoming pressure into rapid offensive repositioning.

🔴 Core Passive & Rotation: Activating her rotation requires managing her two operational combat states: Anchor Trace and Ride the Rapids. Pinging Red and Yellow Orbs builds her internal Tide Mark gauge, allowing her to execute heavy charged weapon slams. Once the meter is optimized, holding down the evade button shifts her into surfboard mode, generating a localized Matrix to gather enemies before consuming her accumulated energy for a devastating Boundless Deluge Ultimate burst.

videos.title: Kurumi Tokisaki | Punishing: Gray Raven | Character Ultimates | Finishers | Brief Moveset Showcase
videos.description:
Punishing: Gray Raven by Kurogames is a fast-paced, ultra-stylish Action-RPG from 2019. The game's name comes from the "Punishing Virus," a biomechanical anomaly that decimated Earth's population, forcing humanity to flee to the space station Babylonia. As a Commandant, you lead the "Gray Raven" special forces unit to reclaim our home.

Combat in PGR is built on a unique 3-Ping Orb System. Instead of standard cooldowns, you chain colored orbs (Red, Yellow, Blue) to trigger powerful skills.

🔴 Matrix (Perfect Dodge): Dodging right as an enemy attacks slows down time and allows you to trigger a 3-Ping effect with just a single orb.
🔴 Core Passive: Each character has a unique "hidden" combo activated by specific orb sequences, which is the key to mastering their damage output and rotation.

Character Overview ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Kurumi Tokisaki is an S-Rank limited collaboration Omniframe that debuted on September 29, 2026. Arriving via the Punishing: Gray Raven × Date A Live V Crossover Event, she joins the roster as a specialized Dark Attacker who commands the flow of time and space on the battlefield.

🔴 Utility: Kurumi Tokisaki excels at true-limited utility, crowd control mitigation, and active survivability. Her specialized evasion framework allows her to seamlessly break out of hard crowd-control locks during sticky situations. Additionally, her unique banner design offers a special discounted R&D ticket pricing mechanic, granting players duplicate bonus copies to aggressively ramp up her rank shards at a lower overall investment compared to standard Omniframes.

🔴 Core Passive & Rotation: Activating her rotation requires managing her Gun Gauge using Red Orbs (Instant Flash) and Blue Orbs (Spiral Bullet). Holding down dodge at a full gauge transitions her into her spiritual state to call forth her giant clock angel, Zafkiel, which instantly triggers a full battlefield time-stop. From here, players execute specific command strings to unlock distinct bullet properties, such as the healing fourth bullet or the imprint-generating eighth bullet, culminating in her massive Seventh Bullet finisher to optimize her rotation output.
